english: Actions are according to intentions, and everyone will get what was intended.
None of you believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself.
He who believes in Allah and the Last Day must either speak good or remain silent.
The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the one who controls himself while in anger.
Allah does not look at your forms or wealth, but He looks at your hearts and deeds.
Every act of goodness is an act of charity.
Facilitate things to people and do not make it hard for them, give them good tidings and do not make them run away.
A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands.
Cleanliness is half of faith and 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to Allah) fills the scale.
The best among you are the best in character.

Take benefit of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before you are preoccupied, and your life before your death.
Verily, gentleness is not found in anything but that it beautifies it, and it is not withdrawn from anything but that it blemishes it.
Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
He is not a believer whose stomach is filled while the neighbor to his side goes hungry.
Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
Part of the perfection of one's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are those that are done consistently, even if they are few.
He who is not merciful to others will not be treated mercifully.
He who treads a path in search of knowledge, Allah will direct him to tread a path to Paradise.
Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow up an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out, and behave toward people with good character.
Richness does not lie in an abundance of worldly goods, but true richness is the richness of the self.
He who does not thank people does not thank Allah.
Whoever relieves a believer of some grief of this world, Allah will relieve him for some grief on the Day of Resurrection.
A supplication made between the Adhan and Iqama is not rejected.
Two words are beloved to the Most Merciful, light on the tongue, and heavy in the balance: Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi, Subhan-Allahil-Azim.
The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was admitted to Paradise, and on it he was expelled from it.
Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on the day of Friday, a light will shine for him from one Friday to the next.
Allah has substituted for you something better than them: the day of al-Adha and the day of al-Fitr.
Fasting on the day of Arafah, I hope that Allah will accept it as expiation for the year that went before it and the year that comes after it.
Fasting on the day of Ashura, I hope that Allah will accept it as expiation for the year that went before it.
Whoever invokes blessings upon me once, Allah sends blessings upon him ten times.
O Allah, make it a beneficial raincloud.
Two are not rejected: supplication at the time of the call to prayer, and under the rain.
O Allah, around us and not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills, the mountains, the valley bottoms, and the places where trees grow.
Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels from the fear of Him.
O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of it.
In the name of Allah is its journey and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
When the heat is intense, delay the prayer until it cools down, for severe heat is from the furious heat of Hellfire.
O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your cattle, spread Your mercy, and bring life to Your dead land.
